trait.name: Hold and Answer
trait.text: Start every fight with 6 Barrier. Guard: when your Barrier stops an enemy attack hit completely, that enemy is left Open until the end of your next turn (one Opening per enemy). The first time each turn you earn an Opening, gain 3 Barrier.

hawk.name: Hawk
hawk.text: Your first Flame spell each turn with damage or Barrier: +3 to each of its damage and Barrier numbers (every hit; not "If" bonuses). Command: 6 damage to a random enemy.

bear.name: Bear
bear.text: Your first Frost spell each turn with damage or Barrier: +3 to each of its damage and Barrier numbers (every hit; not "If" bonuses). Command: gain 5 Barrier.

thunderbird.name: Thunderbird
thunderbird.text: Your first Storm spell each turn with damage or Barrier: +2 to each of its damage and Barrier numbers (every hit; not "If" bonuses). Command: 3 damage to every enemy.

elder.name: Elder Tree
elder.text: Planting it gives 2 Spirit. Your first elemental spell each turn with damage or Barrier: +2 to each of its damage and Barrier numbers (every hit; not "If" bonuses). Command: gain 1 Spirit and draw a card.

owl.name: Moon Owl
owl.text: Whenever Trinity triggers, gain 1 Mana. Command: your next elemental spell costs 0.
